nodes.name: backend-api-delta.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive master list of all backend API changes required for the Waggle OS UX refactor, organized by phase (0–5), covering new routes, extended endpoints, schema migrations, and per-screen backend surface for all 21 screens across sidecar modules like home.ts, artifacts.ts, agents.ts, and mcps.ts.

nodes.name: coverage-check.md
nodes.summary: Adversarial completeness audit of the UX refactor plan, cross-checking all 21 PRD screens, 65 API endpoints, and 11 Definition of Done criteria against the delta documents to surface concrete coverage gaps and prioritize fixes before implementation.

nodes.name: design-system-delta.md
nodes.summary: Maps PRD component requirements to existing Hive DS primitives and identifies net-new components to build for the UX refactor, including color token mappings, dark/light mode strategy, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements.

nodes.name: open-questions.md
nodes.summary: Master decision register for the UX refactor containing founder ratifications (D1–D15) for structural, scope, and launch-integrity decisions, plus unresolved open questions across PRD canonical (A1–A8), cross-cutting (B1–B8), and screen-local (C-section) categories with phase-gating implications.

nodes.name: rbac-security-delta.md
nodes.summary: Security and RBAC gap analysis for the UX refactor, documenting the two existing RBAC planes (tier-based and team-role), approval/consent gating flows, SQLite audit store coverage versus PRD §18 requirements, and recommended build order for the security slice.

nodes.name: shared-types-delta.md
nodes.summary: Type system delta for the UX refactor specifying all new and modified TypeScript types across packages/shared and apps/web, covering Artifact, Agent, Memory with confidence/provenance, Command, MCP, Automation, Skill, and Connector entity models with placement policy and migration guidance.
